title: Content drift between views due to lack of 3D supervision
description: There is little to no communication between opposite views due to the absence of 3D supervision, which can lead to inconsistent 3D assets where properties drift from one view to another. Stronger view conditioning, multi-view supervision, or video generation models are proposed as possible resolutions.
